mapper.insert: INSERT INTO action_logs ( user_id, game_tick, action_type, asset_type, action_amount, market_state, deposit_status, current_cash, current_stock, current_deposit, rt_score_delta, lh_score_delta, rp_score_delta ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{gameTick}, #{actionType}, #{assetType}, #{actionAmount}, #{marketState}, #{depositStatus}, #{currentCash}, #{currentStock}, #{currentDeposit}, #{rtScoreDelta}, #{lhScoreDelta}, #{rpScoreDelta} )
mapper.select: SELECT action_log_id, user_id, game_tick, action_type, asset_type, action_amount, market_state, deposit_status, current_cash, current_stock, current_deposit, rt_score_delta, lh_score_delta, rp_score_delta, created_at FROM action_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY game_tick, action_log_id
